units.source_text: 一切都像做梦，永无醒时。

en.t: Everything seemed like a dream, with no moment of waking.

units.source_text: 茫然执笔作书，胸中愁恨不知多少也！”

en.t: I take up my brush in a daze to write this letter, and who can know how much sorrow and resentment fills my heart!"

units.source_text: 这信写得很零乱，但在旁人看来非常美观。

en.t: The letter was written in great disorder, but to others it looked exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 他们都看出公子对紫姬特别宠爱。

en.t: They all saw that the prince cherished Lady Murasaki with special affection.

units.source_text: 随从诸人也各自写信托使者带去，向故乡亲友诉说须磨生活凄凉。

en.t: The attendants each wrote letters as well and entrusted them to the messenger, telling relatives and friends back home of the desolation of life in Suma.
